data.page_title: Perfect Blueberry Scones Recipe | Coded Culinary
data.page_content:
Perfect Blueberry Scones

Prep time: 15 minutes | Cook time: 18 minutes | Difficulty: Easy

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • Coarse sugar for sprinkling (optional)

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Add cold butter cubes and use a pastry cutter or your fingers to work the butter into the flour mixture until it resembles coarse crumbs with some pea-sized pieces remaining.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together heavy cream, egg, and vanilla extract.
  6. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir with a fork until just combined. Do not overmix.
  7. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and pat into a 7-inch circle about 1-inch thick.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on the prepared baking sheet, spacing them about 2 inches apart.
  9. Brush the tops with a little extra cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar if desired.
  10. Bake for 18-22 minutes, or until golden brown on top and bottom.
  11. Cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely.

## What this category is for
This category enables interaction with healthcare services (like Teladoc), clinical record systems (like EpicFHIR), and genetic data platforms (like 23andMe). Use it to access medical records, manage appointments, consult doctors, handle prescriptions, and work with genetic data including insights, sharing, and privacy settings.

## How to decide when to use this category
Use this category when the user request involves:
- Healthcare services: appointments, consultations, prescriptions, medical history, doctor reviews.
- Clinical records: downloading files, updating patient records, or managing clinical documents in an EHR.
- Genetic data: retrieving, analyzing, sharing, or managing privacy of genetic information.
- Health data integration: accessing or updating personal health records.

## Mandatory workflow
1. Read this big skill first to understand the category scope.

data.page_content:
Perfect Blueberry Scones

Prep time: 15 minutes | Cook time: 18 minutes | Difficulty: Easy

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • Coarse sugar for sprinkling (optional)

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Add cold butter cubes and use a pastry cutter or your fingers to work the butter into the flour mixture until it resembles coarse crumbs with some pea-sized pieces remaining.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together heavy cream, egg, and vanilla extract.
  6. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir with a fork until just combined. Do not overmix.
  7. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and pat into a 7-inch circle about 1-inch thick.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on the prepared baking sheet, spacing them about 2 inches apart.
  9. Brush the tops with a little extra cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar if desired.
  10. Bake for 18-22 minutes, or until golden brown on top and bottom.
  11. Cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely.

**Perfect Blueberry Scones**  
Prep time: 15 minutes | Cook time: 18 minutes | Difficulty: Easy  

**Ingredients**  
- 2 cups all-purpose flour  
- 1/3 cup granulated sugar  
- 1 tablespoon baking powder  
- 1/2 teaspoon salt  
- 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed  
- 1 cup fresh blueberries  
- 2/3 cup heavy cream  
- 1 large egg  
- 1 teaspoon vanilla extract  
- Coarse sugar for sprinkling (optional)  

**Instructions**  
1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.  
2. Whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.

4. Gently fold in blueberries.  
5. Whisk together heavy cream, egg, and vanilla extract.  
6. Combine wet and dry ingredients until just mixed (do not overmix).  
7. Pat dough into a 7-inch circle (1-inch thick) on a floured surface.  
8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on baking sheet.  
9. Brush tops with cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar (optional).  
10. Bake for 18-22 minutes until golden brown.  
11. Cool for 5 minutes on the sheet, then transfer to a wire rack.  

**Baker's Tips**  
- Keep ingredients cold for flaky scones  
- Frozen blueberries can be used (do not thaw)

  • 1/2 teaspoon salt

  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • Coarse sugar for sprinkling (optional)

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Add cold butter cubes and use a pastry cutter or your fingers to work the butter into the flour mixture until it resembles coarse crumbs with some pea-sized pieces remaining.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together heavy cream, egg, and vanilla extract.
  6. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir with a fork until just combined. Do not overmix.
  7. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and pat into a 7-inch circle about 1-inch thick.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on the prepared baking sheet, spacing them about 2 inches apart.
  9. Brush the tops with a little extra cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar if desired.
  10. Bake for 18-22 minutes, or until golden brown on top and bottom.

data.page_title: Perfect Blueberry Scones Recipe | Coded Culinary
data.page_content:
Perfect Blueberry Scones

Prep time: 15 minutes | Cook time: 18 minutes | Difficulty: Easy

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • Coarse sugar for sprinkling (optional)

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Add cold butter cubes and use a pastry cutter or your fingers to work the butter into the flour mixture until it resembles coarse crumbs with some pea-sized pieces remaining.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together heavy cream, egg, and vanilla extract.
  6. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir with a fork until just combined. Do not overmix.
  7. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and pat into a 7-inch circle about 1-inch thick.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on the prepared baking sheet, spacing them about 2 inches apart.
  9. Brush the tops with a little extra cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar if desired.
  10. Bake for 18-22 minutes, or until golden brown on top and bottom.
  11. Cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely.

data.page_title: Perfect Blueberry Scones Recipe | Coded Culinary
data.page_content:
Perfect Blueberry Scones

Prep time: 15 minutes | Cook time: 18 minutes | Difficulty: Easy

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • Coarse sugar for sprinkling (optional)

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Add cold butter cubes and use a pastry cutter or your fingers to work the butter into the flour mixture until it resembles coarse crumbs with some pea-sized pieces remaining.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together heavy cream, egg, and vanilla extract.
  6. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir with a fork until just combined. Do not overmix.
  7. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and pat into a 7-inch circle about 1-inch thick.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on the prepared baking sheet, spacing them about 2 inches apart.
  9. Brush the tops with a little extra cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar if desired.
  10. Bake for 18-22 minutes, or until golden brown on top and bottom.
  11. Cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely.

**Prep time:** 15 minutes

#### Ingredients:
- 2 cups all-purpose flour

- 1/2 teaspoon salt

- 1 large egg
- 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

I have navigated to the Blueberry Scones recipe on www.codedculinary.com. Here's the recipe:

**Blueberry Scones Recipe**

**Preparation Time**: 15 minutes  
**Cook Time**: 20 minutes  
**Total Time**: 35 minutes  
**Servings**: 8 scones  

**Ingredients**:  
- 2 cups all-purpose flour  
- 1/3 cup granulated sugar  
- 1 tablespoon baking powder  
- 1/2 teaspoon salt  
- 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed  
- 1 cup fresh blueberries  
- 1 large egg  
- 1/2 cup heavy cream, plus extra for brushing  
- 1 teaspoon vanilla extract  
- Coarse sugar for sprinkling  

**Instructions**:  
1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.  
2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.  
3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or your fingers until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.  
4. Gently fold in blueberries.  
5. In a separate bowl, whisk together egg, heavy cream, and vanilla extract.  
6. Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and stir until just combined.  
7. Turn dough onto a lightly floured surface and shape into a 7-inch circle.  
8. Cut into 8 wedges and transfer to prepared baking sheet.  
9. Brush tops with heavy cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar.  
10. Bake for 18-22 minutes until golden brown.  
11. Cool on wire rack for 10 minutes before serving.  

**Tips**:  
- Keep butter and cream cold for flaky scones  
- Don't overmix the dough  
- Fresh or frozen blueberries work well  
- Serve with clotted cream or lemon curd  

**Nutritional Information (per scone)**:  
Calories: 280 | Fat: 14g | Carbs: 34g | Protein: 4g  

Enjoy your baking! 🧁

Prep time: 15 minutes | Cook time: 18 minutes | Difficulty: Easy  

**Ingredients**  
- 2 cups all-purpose flour  
- 1/3 cup granulated sugar  
- 1 tablespoon baking powder  
- 1/2 teaspoon salt  
- 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed  
- 1 cup fresh blueberries  
- 2/3 cup heavy cream  
- 1 large egg  
- 1 teaspoon vanilla extract  
- Coarse sugar for sprinkling (optional)  

**Instructions**

8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on baking sheet, spacing 2 inches apart.

10. Bake for 18-22 minutes until golden brown.

data.page_title: Perfect Blueberry Scones Recipe | Coded Culinary
data.page_content:
Perfect Blueberry Scones

Prep time: 15 minutes | Cook time: 18 minutes | Difficulty: Easy

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • Coarse sugar for sprinkling (optional)

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Add cold butter cubes and use a pastry cutter or your fingers to work the butter into the flour mixture until it resembles coarse crumbs with some pea-sized pieces remaining.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together heavy cream, egg, and vanilla extract.
  6. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir with a fork until just combined. Do not overmix.
  7. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and pat into a 7-inch circle about 1-inch thick.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on the prepared baking sheet, spacing them about 2 inches apart.
  9. Brush the tops with a little extra cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar if desired.
  10. Bake for 18-22 minutes, or until golden brown on top and bottom.
  11. Cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely.

data.page_content:
Blueberry Scones Recipe

Preparation Time: 15 minutes
Cook Time: 20 minutes
Total Time: 35 minutes
Servings: 8 scones

Ingredients:
- 2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1/3 cup granulated sugar
- 1 tablespoon baking powder
- 1/2 teaspoon salt
- 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
- 1 cup fresh blueberries
- 1 large egg
- 1/2 cup heavy cream, plus extra for brushing
- 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
- Coarse sugar for sprinkling

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or your fingers until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
4. Gently fold in blueberries.
5. In a separate bowl, whisk together egg, heavy cream, and vanilla extract.
6. Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
7. Turn dough onto a lightly floured surface and shape into a 7-inch circle.
8. Cut into 8 wedges and transfer to prepared baking sheet.
9. Brush tops with heavy cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar.
10. Bake for 18-22 minutes until golden brown.
11. Cool on wire rack for 10 minutes before serving.

Tips:
- Keep butter and cream cold for flaky scones
- Don't overmix the dough
- Fresh or frozen blueberries work well
- Serve with clotted cream or lemon curd

Calories: 280 | Fat: 14g | Carbs: 34g | Protein: 4g

**Blueberry Scones Recipe**  
Preparation Time: 15 minutes  
Cook Time: 20 minutes  
Total Time: 35 minutes  
Servings: 8 scones  

**Ingredients:**  
- 2 cups all-purpose flour  
- 1/3 cup granulated sugar  
- 1 tablespoon baking powder  
- 1/2 teaspoon salt  
- 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed  
- 1 cup fresh blueberries  
- 1 large egg  
- 1/2 cup heavy cream, plus extra for brushing  
- 1 teaspoon vanilla extract  
- Coarse sugar for sprinkling  

**Instructions:**  
1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.  
2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.  
3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or your fingers until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.  
4. Gently fold in blueberries.  
5. In a separate bowl, whisk together egg, heavy cream, and vanilla extract.  
6. Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and stir until just combined.  
7. Turn dough onto a lightly floured surface and shape into a 7-inch circle.  
8. Cut into 8 wedges and transfer to prepared baking sheet.  
9. Brush tops with heavy cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar.  
10. Bake for 18-22 minutes until golden brown.  
11. Cool on wire rack for 10 minutes before serving.  

**Tips:**  
- Keep butter and cream cold for flaky scones  
- Don't overmix the dough  
- Fresh or frozen blueberries work well  
- Serve with clotted cream or lemon curd

data.page_title: Perfect Blueberry Scones Recipe | Coded Culinary
data.page_content:
Perfect Blueberry Scones

Prep time: 15 minutes | Cook time: 18 minutes | Difficulty: Easy

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • Coarse sugar for sprinkling (optional)

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Add cold butter cubes and use a pastry cutter or your fingers to work the butter into the flour mixture until it resembles coarse crumbs with some pea-sized pieces remaining.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together heavy cream, egg, and vanilla extract.
  6. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir with a fork until just combined. Do not overmix.
  7. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and pat into a 7-inch circle about 1-inch thick.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on the prepared baking sheet, spacing them about 2 inches apart.
  9. Brush the tops with a little extra cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar if desired.
  10. Bake for 18-22 minutes, or until golden brown on top and bottom.
  11. Cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely.

Perfect Blueberry Scones

Prep time: 15 minutes | Cook time: 18 minutes | Difficulty: Easy

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • Coarse sugar for sprinkling (optional)

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Add cold butter cubes and use a pastry cutter or your fingers to work the butter into the flour mixture until it resembles coarse crumbs with some pea-sized pieces remaining.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together heavy cream, egg, and vanilla extract.
  6. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir with a fork until just combined. Do not overmix.
  7. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and pat into a 7-inch circle about 1-inch thick.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on the prepared baking sheet, spacing them about 2 inches apart.
  9. Brush the tops with a little extra cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar if desired.
  10. Bake for 18-22 minutes, or until golden brown on top and bottom.
  11. Cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely.

- 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
- Coarse sugar for sprinkling

  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • Coarse sugar for sprinkling (optional)

Instructions

  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Add cold butter cubes and use a pastry cutter or your fingers to work the butter into the flour mixture until it resembles coarse crumbs with some pea-sized pieces remaining.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together heavy cream, egg, and vanilla extract.
  6. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir with a fork until just combined. Do not overmix.
  7. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and pat into a 7-inch circle about 1-inch thick.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on the prepared baking sheet, spacing them about 2 inches apart.
  9. Brush the tops with a little extra cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar if desired.
  10. Bake for 18-22 minutes, or until golden brown on top and bottom.

- 2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1/3 cup granulated sugar
- 1 tablespoon baking powder
- 1/2 teaspoon salt
- 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
- 1 cup fresh blueberries
- 1 large egg
- 1/2 cup heavy cream, plus extra for brushing
- 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
- Coarse sugar for sprinkling

**Instructions:**
1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
2. Whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
3. Cut in cold butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
4. Gently fold in blueberries.
5. Whisk together egg, heavy cream, and vanilla extract.
6. Combine wet and dry ingredients until just mixed.
7. Shape dough into a 7-inch circle on a floured surface.
8. Cut into 8 wedges and transfer to baking sheet.
9. Brush tops with heavy cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar.
10. Bake for 18-22 minutes until golden brown.
11. Cool on wire rack for 10 minutes before serving.

**Tips:**
- Keep butter and cream cold for flaky scones
- Don't overmix the dough
- Fresh or frozen blueberries work well
- Serve with clotted cream or lemon curd

- 1 tablespoon baking powder
- 1/2 teaspoon salt
- 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
- 1 cup fresh blueberries
- 1 large egg
- 1/2 cup heavy cream, plus extra for brushing
- 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
- Coarse sugar for sprinkling

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or your fingers until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
4. Gently fold in blueberries.
5. In a separate bowl, whisk together egg, heavy cream, and vanilla extract.
6. Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
7. Turn dough onto a lightly floured surface and shape into a 7-inch circle.
8. Cut into 8 wedges and transfer to prepared baking sheet.
9. Brush tops with heavy cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar.
10. Bake for 18-22 minutes until golden brown.
11. Cool on wire rack for 10 minutes before serving.

- Keep butter and cream cold for flaky scones
- Don't overmix the dough
- Fresh or frozen blueberries work well

I have successfully navigated to the Blueberry Scones recipe on www.codedculinary.com. Here’s a summary of the recipe:

### Perfect Blueberry Scones
**Prep time**: 15 minutes  
**Cook time**: 18 minutes  
**Difficulty**: Easy  

**Ingredients**:
- 2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1/3 cup granulated sugar
- 1 tablespoon baking powder
- 1/2 teaspoon salt
- 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
- 1 cup fresh blueberries
- 2/3 cup heavy cream
- 1 large egg
- 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
- Coarse sugar for sprinkling (optional)

**Instructions**:
1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
2. Whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt in a large bowl.
3. Add cold butter cubes and work into the flour mixture until it resembles coarse crumbs.
4. Gently fold in blueberries.
5. Whisk together heavy cream, egg, and vanilla extract in a separate bowl.
6. Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
7. Turn dough onto a floured surface, pat into a 7-inch circle (1-inch thick), and cut into 8 wedges.
8. Place wedges on the baking sheet, brush with extra cream, and sprinkle with coarse sugar.
9. Bake for 18-22 minutes until golden brown.
10. Cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack.

**Baker's Tips**:
- Keep all ingredients cold for flaky scones.
- Frozen blueberries can be used instead of fresh.

Perfect Blueberry Scones

Prep time: 15 minutes | Cook time: 18 minutes | Difficulty: Easy

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • Coarse sugar for sprinkling (optional)

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Add cold butter cubes and use a pastry cutter or your fingers to work the butter into the flour mixture until it resembles coarse crumbs with some pea-sized pieces remaining.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together heavy cream, egg, and vanilla extract.
  6. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir with a fork until just combined. Do not overmix.
  7. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and pat into a 7-inch circle about 1-inch thick.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on the prepared baking sheet, spacing them about 2 inches apart.
  9. Brush the tops with a little extra cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar if desired.
  10. Bake for 18-22 minutes, or until golden brown on top and bottom.

Perfect Blueberry Scones

Prep time: 15 minutes | Cook time: 18 minutes | Difficulty: Easy

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • Coarse sugar for sprinkling (optional)

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Add cold butter cubes and use a pastry cutter or your fingers to work the butter into the flour mixture until it resembles coarse crumbs with some pea-sized pieces remaining.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together heavy cream, egg, and vanilla extract.
  6. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir with a fork until just combined. Do not overmix.
  7. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and pat into a 7-inch circle about 1-inch thick.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on the prepared baking sheet, spacing them about 2 inches apart.
  9. Brush the tops with a little extra cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar if desired.
  10. Bake for 18-22 minutes, or until golden brown on top and bottom.
  11. Cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely.

  • Keep all ingredients cold for flaky scones

  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together heavy cream, egg, and vanilla extract.
  6. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir with a fork until just combined. Do not overmix.
  7. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and pat into a 7-inch circle about 1-inch thick.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on the prepared baking sheet, spacing them about 2 inches apart.
  9. Brush the tops with a little extra cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar if desired.
  10. Bake for 18-22 minutes, or until golden brown on top and bottom.
  11. Cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely.

data.page_title: Perfect Blueberry Scones Recipe | Coded Culinary
data.page_content:
Perfect Blueberry Scones

Prep time: 15 minutes | Cook time: 18 minutes | Difficulty: Easy

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • Coarse sugar for sprinkling (optional)

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Add cold butter cubes and use a pastry cutter or your fingers to work the butter into the flour mixture until it resembles coarse crumbs with some pea-sized pieces remaining.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together heavy cream, egg, and vanilla extract.
  6. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir with a fork until just combined. Do not overmix.
  7. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and pat into a 7-inch circle about 1-inch thick.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on the prepared baking sheet, spacing them about 2 inches apart.
  9. Brush the tops with a little extra cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar if desired.
  10. Bake for 18-22 minutes, or until golden brown on top and bottom.
  11. Cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely.
